//: This repository's OWN configuration, committed so it travels. The audit plugin under plugins/audit/ is the product; the hooks below are how this repo governs itself — its releases (guard-release.py, armed by arm-release-bypass.py), the claims a commit owes (require-claim-block.py), and the work a tree-wide destructive git command would take away (guard-uncommitted.py). Each says in its own docstring why it exists and which way it fails.
